text:
Taylor (Hiring Manager): Need a compact manager-facing onboarding checklist for new ICs — focused, copy-pasteable for future hires. Also want a one-page 30/60/90 list and a week-1 agenda that covers access, meetups, and a tiny first deliverable.
Morgan (People Ops): Drafted a slim manager checklist below. Happy to drop into the shared onboarding templates.
Alex (IT): I'll start device and SSO flow once you DM me user info. For now tell me mac vs win and preferred laptop shipping address.
Priya (HR): Payroll + benefits link needs to go in the welcome DM. Also confirm time zone so we can set up calendar invites correctly.
Ravi (Peer/Buddy): I can be buddy for the new hire. Happy to do a 30-min pairing session on day 2 and run through the codebase basics.
Morgan (People Ops): Manager checklist (copy this into new hire doc):
```
Manager onboarding checklist - week 0/1
- Pre-day: confirm device, create account invites (SSO, email, Slack), add to team calendar events
- Day 0: HR paperwork + benefits link, welcome Slack intro, send 1-page agenda
- Day 1: 60-min product overview (buddy + manager), access verification (repos, staging)
- Day 2: small first ticket assigned (read-only -> write), pair with buddy for 2 hours
- Day 3: stakeholder intros + 30min goals sync (manager)
- Day 4: metrics & tooling overview, scheduling recurring 1:1s (weekly for first 8 weeks)
- End of week: clear 30/60/90 expectations & success signals, feedback check-in
```
Taylor (Hiring Manager): Love the brevity. Can you add a 3-line 30/60/90 I can paste in an offer follow-up?
Morgan (People Ops): Yep. 30/60/90 (one-paragraph/3 bullets):
- 30 days: understand product surface, complete onboarding tasks, deliver a scoped discovery doc or prototype.
- 60 days: take ownership of a small backlog, run a cross-functional sync, propose 2 process improvements.
- 90 days: lead a small project from planning to release, demonstrate measurable change on metric Y, established stakeholder cadence.
Alex (IT): Note: if VPN or HSM access is required, allow extra 5 business days. Ping me with specific SaaS list.
Ravi (Peer/Buddy): Quick who-to-ask list for eng newcomers (I'll add to the doc): repo -> Devops team (Sam), staging -> QA channel, deploys -> Ravi / Eng Lead.
Priya (HR): Reminder: security training and code of conduct ack due within 5 business days to avoid blocked accesses.
Taylor (Hiring Manager): Can we include 3 success signals managers should drop in the doc? (what 'good' looks like at 30/60/90)
Morgan (People Ops): I'll seed them — please tweak: 30: shipped first scoped discovery + doc; 60: running cross-team sync and independent PRs; 90: owned a release and improved metric or process.
onboard-bot: Calendar events created: "New hire welcome" (Day 0 10:00), "Product deep-dive" (Day 1 09:30), "Buddy pairing" (Day 2 11:00).
Alex (IT): Device order placed. Shipping ETA 3 business days. Temporary cloud account available if needed.
Taylor (Hiring Manager): Great, I'll copy this into the candidate DM and the #new-hires doc. Morgan 94 please attach the checklist to the template and mark as manager-copyable.
Morgan (People Ops): Done 94 added as "manager-slim-checklist" to templates. I'll ping the team to add any role-specific items by EOD Thursday. :tada:
